channel.title: The Mutapa Times — Daily Zimbabwe Weather + Tsumo
channel.description: Daily weather forecast for Zimbabwe's main cities plus the Tsumo yezuva (proverb of the day). One item per day, dedicated for the Mutapa Times weather autolist.

item.title: Zim weather 14 Oct: Harare mainly clear · high 29° / low 18°
item.description: Harare: high 29°, low 18° (mainly clear) · Bulawayo: high 32°, low 18° (mainly clear) · Mutare: high 28°, low 17° (foggy) · Gweru: high 30°, low 17° (partly cloudy) · Masvingo: high 31°, low 18° (overcast) · Victoria Falls: high 37°, low 21° (mainly clear) Tsumo yezuva: Kuzeza chati kwati hunge uine katurike.
